comparison.objective: Place raw meat, poultry, and fish on their corresponding color-coded cutting boards; candidate removes HELICOIL tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Classify protein types and perform contamination-aware placement versus precision mandrel manipulation, bimanual hammering, and fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Each protein is on the correct coded board versus all four tangs fractured and deposited with inserts and shell undamaged.
comparison.reason: Category-to-board sorting is unrelated to impact finishing. Cross-contamination rules, placement tolerances, scoring, and spec versions are missing.
